subject: general
question: An alliance formed by political parties after elections when no party has been able to get adequate seats to form a clear majority is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**coalition**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A coalition government is a type of government where two or more political parties join together in parliament/ assembly to run the government and agree on a policy program.

 
 
• A coalition government is a cabinet of a parliamentary government in which several parties cooperate.
 
• The usual reason given for this arrangement is that no party on its own can achieve a majority in the parliament.
 
• A coalition government might also be created in a time of national difficulty or crisis, for example during wartime, to give a government the high degree of perceived political legitimacy it desires and also playing a role in diminishing internal political strife.
 
• In such times, parties have formed all-party coalitions (national unity governments, grand coalitions).
 
• If a coalition collapses a confidence vote is held or a motion of no confidence is taken.
 
• A coalition government is oftentimes considered a very weak form of government because there is no majority party.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appropriation**

 
 
• Appropriation Bill gives power to the government to withdraw funds from the Consolidated Fund of India for meeting the expenditure during the financial year.
 
• It is introduced by Finance Minister.
 
• It is introduced in Lok Sabha.
 
• It gives the legal power to the Govt. for expenditure.
 
 
 
• **prorogation**
 
 
• Prorogation is the action of discontinuing a session of the House without dissolving it.
 
• Once the Business of the Session is completed, The Presiding officer declares the House adjourned sine die, Then within a few days, the President issues a notification for Prorogation of the Session.
 
• The President can Prorogue the House while it is in session.
 
• It terminates both, the sitting of the house and the session of the house.​
